positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 2.67% (49.3m shares) as of 2026-09-18, up from 1.46% on 2026-09-11, lag 3 sessions. The build is in the week of S&P/ASX 300 inclusion. LIN was added effective the open of 21 Sept (S&P DJI, 04/09/2026, https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/displayAnnouncement.do?display=pdf&idsId=03136141), and 18 Sept, the index-rebalance close and the as-of date of this register print, traded 157.5m shares against a 6 to 15m norm. UBS became substantial on 16 Sept, largely through prime/securities-lending nominees (Brispot, Warbont, UBS Securities Australia; https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/displayAnnouncement.do?display=pdf&idsId=03140309), and ceased on 22 Sept (idsId 03142356). That is the shape of index-event inventory and stock-loan activity, not a fundamental bear building, and much of it has probably unwound already. The next ASIC prints (21 to 25 Sept) will show it, but a register print is not a price catalyst. Regal was trimming (604, 14 Sept, idsId 03139331). The lean's short_building component (-2.0) is therefore probably mislabelled on this name. The squeeze component (+1.6) is equally weak, because 2.7% short on a name turning over ~A$7m a day is not crowded. So I read the lean as near-zero information and do not trade against it.

outside_window.finding: Front-end commissioning of the Kangankunde Stage 1 plant is targeted for October 2026 and practical completion for mid-November, with first monazite concentrate by end-2026. Any slip or early start would be announced after 28 Sept. I did not size it for this window.

The September-quarter Appendix 5B and activities report, the real cash-flow print for this filer type. It is due by 31 Oct and was lodged 30 Oct in both 2024 and 2025. It will show the first quarter of heavy Stage 1 capex and SARECO spend against the A$107.9m opening cash.
